curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Who is orchestrating the uprising of liberated Universal Soldiers, and why is John being hunted down by them?
curatedMovie.description: After his wife and daughter are slaughtered in a home invasion, John finds himself pursued by an army of Universal Soldiers whose enigmatic leader vows to liberate the fighters from their conditioning.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, grim, and suspenseful sci-fi combat designed for tense, fully engaged solo viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director John Hyams drives a brutal sci-fi action thriller where heavy grief fuels a relentless, high-octane chase against formidable superhuman combatants.
